newsitem.title: UK: NWE straight-run fuel oil talked higher.
newsitem.headline: NWE straight-run fuel oil talked higher.

text.p: European straight run was talked at slightly higher prices on Thursday but buyers and sellers were far apart in their assessment of its near future levels. "There's more demand than supply," one seller said, echoing other traders' perceptions that straight-run was talked firmer at a $106/$108 bid/offer range on the back of the fundamentals. The trader said he moved 5,000 tonnes of low sulphur straight-run on barges into Germany at $108.50 fob a tonne. The previous two cargo deals were done this week at around the $105 mark. Other traders, mainly buyers arguing they have a choice of some five cargoes on offer in Northern Europe, said straight-run was assessed $2 lower. "There's several cargoes on offer...I would say it is steady (at last done), neither long nor short," one trader said.
